subject: Kickoff: matrix compression for the serving fleet
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Kicking off the matrix compression workstream for efficiency. The library injects compression ops into the TensorFlow training graph so weight tensors are compressed while the model is being trained - not as a lossy afterthought at export time. The API surface is in good shape: MatrixCompressorInterface for the algorithm, CompressionOpInterface for the graph injection, and the ApplyCompression wrapper that walks layers and applies the chosen compression_option. Smoothed compression gives us a knob to trade accuracy against ratio during training.

Product target: cut serving memory for the three biggest internal models by 3-4x with under 1% quality loss, which Zeke's team can turn directly into fleet capacity.

Milestones: library integrated with one flagship model by 3/20, compression-vs-quality curves by 4/17, rollout recommendation by 5/15.

Yusuf leads research, Emeka tooling, Linnea training integration. Staffing and compute from you by Friday?

Zofia
